scope: Theorem 1.1 (Planar endpoint convergence) of the manuscript “Endpoint convergence for the planar Schrodinger equation” (preprints/Endpoint-convergence-for-the-planar-Schrodinger-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 68d6affc8c3cc3bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every f ∈ H1/3(R2) there is a set Ef ⊂ R2 of full Lebesgue measure such that, for each x ∈ Ef , the finite limit uf (x, t) = lim a↓0 Uaf(x, t) exists for every real 0 < t < 1, and lim t↓0 uf (x, t) = f∗ (x). In fact uf (x, ·) extends continuously to [0, 1) with value f∗(x) at zero, and the Gaussian limit is uniform over 0 < t < 1.
